Theater Mode engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume watchOS cinema-dim behavior covers storefront language. watchOS Control Center, alert silencing, and App Store Connect actually separate on-device Theater Mode behavior from product-page copy:

  • Control Center masks or cinema toggle — quick Theater Mode on/off from Apple Watch Control Center. zh-Hans watchOS labels the tile 剧院模式. Does not generate Chinese listing text by itself.
  • Silenced alerts and haptics — while Theater Mode is on, sounds and haptic taps stay muted so the watch does not disturb a dark theater. Listing copy may show this on screenshots; teaching buyers why cinema silence matters is listing work, not engineering.
  • Dim display on wrist raise — when Theater Mode is active, raising the wrist does not fully light the display in a dark room. Gallery frames may highlight Don't light up in a theater or 手腕抬起不亮屏 on education frames.
  • Companion app documentation — your app may explain when to enable Theater Mode before a film. Your description may mention that behavior; implementing alert or display policies is engineering — distinct from zh-Hans caption lines.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Theater Mode features in the binary.

A working Theater Mode or cinema-dim story on device and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

FAQ

What is Apple Watch Theater Mode and where do buyers turn it on?

Theater Mode silences alerts and keeps the Apple Watch display dark when the wearer raises their wrist in a dark theater or cinema. Buyers enable it from Control Center on Apple Watch by tapping the masks or cinema icon. Simplified Chinese watchOS labels it 剧院模式.

Does a cinema-dim watchOS app auto-translate Theater Mode marketing on the China listing?

No. Raise-to-wake display behavior and alert silencing in the binary control in-app behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback.

How is Theater Mode different from iPhone Camera Cinematic Mode and Photos Cinematic album?

Camera Cinematic Mode covers shallow-depth video capture — 电影效果, 浅景深. Photos Cinematic album covers 电影相簿 collections. Theater Mode covers watchOS cinema dim and raise-to-wake mute — 剧院模式 — on Apple Watch Control Center.

How is Theater Mode different from Silent Mode and Focus?

Silent Mode is mute-only — saved for its own page. Focus silences notification profiles — 专注模式. Theater Mode dims the display on wrist raise and silences alerts for cinema use — 剧院模式 — not a Focus picker or mute-only toggle alone.

How is Theater Mode different from Water Lock, AOD, and Watch Faces?

Water Lock covers swimming crown lock — 水下锁定. AOD covers dimmed always-on glances — 全天候显示. Watch Faces covers face gallery browsing — 表盘图库. Theater Mode covers cinema dim on wrist raise — 剧院模式.
